expected_calibration_error_definition: expected calibration error = sum over non-empty bins of (n_bin / n_scored) * |agreement_bin - mean_argmax_probability_bin|, where agreement_bin is the fraction of that bin's outcomes whose argmax was the best-ranked option. It is a gap between what the head claimed and what the closure table found; it is not an accuracy, and it says nothing about whether the ranked-first pipeline was any good.
